segments.title: World's biggest desert?
segments.say: Quick quiz. What's the biggest desert on Earth?

segments.title: Pick one
segments.say: Sahara, Gobi, or Antarctica? Lock it in. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Desert = very little rain
segments.say: A desert is about how little rain or snow falls, not how hot it is.

segments.title: About 14 million km²
segments.say: Britannica lists the Antarctic ice sheet at about fourteen million square kilometers.
